translation: Convoy No. 3905 (Yokosuka to Haha-jima; escorts Yasojima, Hachijo, CD-4, CD-12): BANG torpedoes and sinks both Tokiwasan Maru and Shoryu Maru at 28-58N 137-45E
note: Secondary. The page has the convoy leaving Tateyama at 1520 and sunk "at about 1600, shortly after the ships leave port", but the position is ~350 nm south of Tateyama; FRUPAC's intercept has "torp & sunk 1520/09" (frupac.csv F02), so 1520 I is likely the attack, not a departure. Time left blank here for that reason. DANFS: 1,804-ton Tokiwasan Maru and 1,916-ton Shoryu Maru. No primary record found yet (convoy was under Yokosuka, not the 1st or 4th Surface Escort Division)

original: 海防三〇、掃一五、三拓南丸、七利丸、太安丸、三号太平丸 タカ九〇九船団護衛 / 海防三〇、太安丸陸軍飛行機ト共ニN二四─五四 E一二二─二三ニ於テタカ九〇九船団ヲ雷撃セル敵潜水艦攻撃 / 被害 第二東勢丸沈没 戦果 敵潜水艦一隻撃沈
translation: CD-30, W-15, No. 3 Takunan Maru, Shichiri Maru, Taian Maru, No. 3 Taihei Maru: escorting convoy TAKA-909. / CD-30 and Taian Maru, with army aircraft, attack the enemy submarine that torpedoed convoy TAKA-909 at N 24°54′ E 122°23′. / Damage: No. 2 Tosei Maru sunk. Result: one enemy submarine sunk
note: 4th Surface Escort Division / Okinawa Base Force war diary, September 1944, 作戦経過概要 (daily operations summary), column 19. No time given. The "submarine sunk" was BANG, which surfaced that night after about 80 charges. 東勢 is read Tosei (DANFS: 507-ton tanker No. 2 Tosei Maru). TAKA = Takao to Kagoshima. The columns for the 20th and 21st have no attack, so nothing yet for BANG's Attacks 5-6 (2315 I on the 20th)

original: (イ) 九日一五二〇 須美寿島ノ二六五度一〇浬ニテ 昌隆丸 常盤山丸 被雷撃沈没
translation: (a) 9th, 1520, 265° 10 nm from Sumisu-jima: Shoryu Maru and Tokiwasan Maru torpedoed and sunk
note: Yokosuka Guard Squadron war diary, September 1944, 一 経過 (二) 敵潜水艦ノ出現 (losses to submarines). Zone not stated; taken as I (Tokyo), assumed. The position is a bearing from Sumisu-jima (須美寿島, about 31-26N 140-03E), which puts it near 31-25N 139-51E: about 188 nm north-east of BANG's attacks (28-53N 137-42E) and of the postwar position combinedfleet gives (28-58N 137-45E, J01). Left as written. The time is 4 minutes after BANG's first salvo (1616 K = 1516 I). The convoy is not named here
